shelters.name: Humane Animal Partners - Wilmington
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter formed in 2022 from merger of Delaware Humane Association and Delaware SPCA. Offers low-cost vet care and adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Animal Partners - Stanton
shelters.description: Stanton/Newark location of Humane Animal Partners providing shelter, adoption, and low-cost veterinary services.

shelters.name: Humane Animal Partners - Rehoboth Beach
shelters.description: Sussex County location serving the Rehoboth Beach area with adoption and animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Brandywine Valley SPCA - New Castle
shelters.description: Copeland Center campus striving to end animal suffering and empower communities. Delaware contracts with BVSPCA for statewide animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Brandywine Valley SPCA - Georgetown
shelters.description: Georgetown campus serving Sussex County with animal shelter, adoption, and welfare services.

shelters.name: Brandywine Valley SPCA - Animal Rescue Center
shelters.description: Animal Rescue Center in Georgetown area providing rescue operations and animal health services.

shelters.name: Faithful Friends Animal Society
shelters.description: Private nonprofit with no-kill shelter and community veterinary clinic. All animals stay until placed in new homes. Pet Life Line available for guidance.

shelters.name: First State Animal Center and SPCA
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing animal control for entire state except Wilmington. Only Delaware shelter that can house large animals. Offers 24-hour dispatch service.

shelters.name: Forgotten Cats
shelters.description: Founded in 2003, leading TNVR nonprofit in the region servicing DE, PA, MD, and NJ. Specializes in humanely reducing homeless cat population.

shelters.name: Safe Haven Cat Sanctuary
shelters.description: Home to feral cats without safe places to live, providing lifelong perpetual care. Focuses on socialization, vetting, and adoption of kittens born to feral cats.

shelters.name: Safe Haven Animal Sanctuary of Sussex County
shelters.description: No-kill animal sanctuary serving Sussex County with rescue and rehoming services.

shelters.name: Purrfect Haven Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving Delaware with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Coastal Cats Rescue of Delaware
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving the Bethany Beach and Sussex County coastal area.

shelters.name: Sussex County Animal Association / Whimsical Cats
shelters.description: Animal association and cat rescue serving Sussex County in Seaford area.

shelters.name: Homeless Cat Helpers
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization helping homeless cats in the Seaford and Sussex County area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Delaware animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Delaware is a small state with several major organizations: Humane Animal Partners (formed 2022 from merger), Brandywine Valley SPCA (state contractor for animal welfare), Faithful Friends, and First State Animal Center. Coverage spans New Castle, Kent, and Sussex counties.
